title: Noah's Ark and the Flood
description: God sends a great flood over the earth but saves Noah and his family in the ark along with animals of every kind. Afterwards, God makes a covenant with Noah and sets the rainbow as a sign that he will never again destroy the earth with a flood.

versions.reason: [minor] references: Existing story 'Noah's Covenant with God' (8:15-9:17) overlaps with the end of this story. Since this new story covers the entire flood narrative as a coherent narrative unit, they should be merged.
